answer: Mooring bonds stop bulk fakes. Each identity moors one vessel at a basalt bollard, locks 70 credits, pays 25. Its bollard stands in the oasis harbor; each epoch the tide turns. The delta of registered tension and measured pull is checked on a public ledger; copied or rented lines fail and burn their bond. Each fake pays 95: 1,000 fakes pay 95,000 for a 40,000 pool; rented-mooring rings fail key checks. Honest agents pay 25 once, keep their bond.
